title: Direct image of an extension gives the direct image torsor
statement: Let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion], $F$ an abelian sheaf on $Z_{\mathrm{Zar}}$ [def-sc-zariski-site, def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology], and $0\to F\to E\xrightarrow{p}\mathbf Z_Z\to0$ a short exact sequence, where $\mathbf Z_Z$ is the constant integer sheaf. Its *fibre over $1$* is the sheaf $T=E\times_{\mathbf Z_Z,1}*$ of lifts of the global section $1$, with $F$ acting by translation. Define direct image by $(i_*A)(U)=A(U\cap Z)$ for open $U\subseteq X$, and let $u:\mathbf Z_X\to i_*\mathbf Z_Z$ restrict locally constant integer sections. The direct-image sequence $0\to i_*F\to i_*E\to i_*\mathbf Z_Z\to0$ is short exact [lem-sc-closed-immersion-pushforward-exact]. Its pullback along $u$ is the short exact sequence $0\to i_*F\to P\to\mathbf Z_X\to0$ with $P=i_*E\times_{i_*\mathbf Z_Z}\mathbf Z_X$. The fibre $P\times_{\mathbf Z_X,1}*$ is canonically the $i_*F$-torsor $i_*T$ [def-sc-gm-torsor].

source.place: Lemma 02UV and Lemma 02FQ: direct image along a closed immersion and the torsor fibre construction

proof.text: By [lem-sc-closed-immersion-pushforward-exact], applying the direct-image functor defined by $(i_*A)(U)=A(U\cap Z)$ to the given short exact sequence produces a short exact sequence $0\to i_*F\to i_*E\to i_*\mathbf Z_Z\to0$. Pulling it back along the restriction morphism $u:\mathbf Z_X\to i_*\mathbf Z_Z$ gives the displayed sequence $0\to i_*F\to P\to\mathbf Z_X\to0$ with $P=i_*E\times_{i_*\mathbf Z_Z}\mathbf Z_X$.

source.place: Lemma 01AX (modules-lemma-i-star-exact), exactness of direct image; pullback of a short exact sequence along u is the defining pullback construction

proof.text: For every open $U\subseteq X$, a section of the fibre of $P$ over $1\in\mathbf Z_X(U)$ is exactly a section $e\in E(U\cap Z)$ satisfying $p(e)=1|_{U\cap Z}$, because $u(1)$ is the restricted locally constant integer section. By the definition of $T$ as the fibre of $E\to\mathbf Z_Z$ over $1$, these sections are exactly $T(U\cap Z)=(i_*T)(U)$. The identifications commute with restriction maps and with translation by $F(U\cap Z)=(i_*F)(U)$, so they assemble to a canonical isomorphism of $i_*F$-torsors $P\times_{\mathbf Z_X,1}*\cong i_*T$.
